verdict.rationale: Ironclad's own developer docs describe a public REST API that can drive the product programmatically. It includes Records and Workflows APIs to create, retrieve, update and interact with contracts and workflows, single and bulk workflow launch, data exports, and programmatic control of approvals and documents, with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth. Probes confirm agent-friendly docs: llms.txt and markdown doc pages both return HTTP 200. Missing for 10: API access is gated behind a paid API add-on, no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths probed, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
